Hi Fernando, it's Ricardo, from Finance. I have the numbers for the first two months of the pilot, and they are good. We hosted eight families, for a total of one hundred and ninety nights. We didn't spend much money on furniture, because a lot of it came from donations. We spent only four thousand reais. The supplies cost a little more than we assumed: about one thousand five hundred reais a month. So, how many apartments do we need next year? My answer is: maybe six. But I don't have much time this week, so let's talk about it on Monday.

Hi Fernando, it's Sarah. I'm at the airport now, and I just want to say thank you. I was really impressed with the pilot. In Texas, we have a lot of apartments, but we don't have many volunteers, and your volunteers make a big difference. I have a little feedback for you, too. The families need more space for the children, and a few of them asked for a washing machine in the apartment. The facilities are good, but I think a small playroom might be worth it. Let's put these ideas in our report next week. Bye for now!
